parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page is displayed or no </ph></props>ID value is displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: JobId
parameters.description:
The ID of the upgrade batch.

This is the **JobId** returned when you call [CreateOTADynamicUpgradeJob](~~147887~~) to create a batch. You can also view the batch ID on the **Firmware Details** page of the firmware in the IoT Platform console.
